entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel on windows does not support SChannel autoactivation of new certificate like HTTP.Sys #63980
  • Optimize the implementation of the `_MvcCopyDependencyFiles` Target in the Mvc.Testing.targets #63977
  • InteractiveAuto is not working #63973
  • Debug mode works but release fails to start. both work with same solution in VS 2022 #63971
  • There are some errors "MONO_WASM: mono_wasm_load_runtime () failed" when go to the Counter page after publish the Blazor WebAssembly app #63970
  • ResponseCompression tests should verify functionality, not exact compressed byte counts #63969

Closed

    .NET 11 Planning
  • JavaScript for Kids: A Playful Introduction to Programming #63974
